title: Visual Blueprint Materials
description: Displays a visual material list and inventory tracking for Create blueprints directly on container and inventory screens.
body:
# Mod Introduction
This project includes code developed with AI assistance and manually reviewed by the author.
Visual Blueprint Materials is a Create add-on that parses blueprint clipboard NBT data to display a visual material list and current inventory counts on inventory, chest, AE2, and RS terminal screens. The side panel intelligently positions itself to avoid overlapping with item slots or JEI, allowing players to track requirements, toggle collected or ignored items directly into the clipboard NBT, and lock the panel to auto-open with containers. It supports JEI recipe lookups via R/U keys and requires Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47.x, and Create 0.5.x or 6.x.

Authored by AlkSur under the MIT License, this project is free for personal and non-profit server use, while any commercial application, including paid modpacks or monetized servers, requires explicit written authorization.
